units.name: Electrical Power Products (EP²)
units.focus: Engineered-to-order protective relay and control panels, drop-in-place integrated control enclosures (substation control buildings) and the auxiliary AC/DC power fitted in them, for utility, generation, transmission, distribution, renewables and data centres. Des Moines, Iowa; acquisition completed May 2026.

units.name: Crown Technical Systems
units.focus: Medium-voltage metal-clad switchgear 4.16-38 kV (arc-resistant to IEEE C37.20.7 and standard to C37.20.2), protective relay, metering and communication panels, and enclosures (E-House, power control assembly, power distribution centre, traction power substation). Sites: Fontana CA, Dallas TX, Ontario Canada.

units.name: Anord Mardix
units.focus: Data-centre LV switchgear and switchboards (IEC 61439-2, UL 891), MV switchgear and RMUs, packaged substations, busway, PDUs and remote power panels, static transfer switches, panelboards, prefabricated power pods and skids, power management (EMS, DCIM, circuit monitoring, SCADA) and field services. Mostly configure-to-order.

units.name: Flex Power Modules
units.focus: Board-level DC/DC power modules (isolated bricks, intermediate bus converters, point-of-load, integrated power stages, 48 V direct conversion, 800 VDC modules, RFPA and railway converters, power interface modules), plus custom rack power: AI rack power shelves, capacitive energy storage, vertical power delivery and a 1 MW+ DC PDU / 800 VDC power rack.

units.name: JetCool
units.focus: Direct-to-chip liquid cooling: SmartPlate cold plates (350 W to over 3 kW per processor), liquid-assisted air cooling, in-rack and row coolant distribution units (up to 1.8 MW), in-rack manifolds and quick disconnects, custom and direct-to-die cooling.

units.name: Cloud (in-house)
units.focus: Compute and storage joint design and manufacturing (PCA and box build), data-centre racks and enclosures (19 in, OCP ORV3), node- and rack-level integration including 1 MW liquid-cooled IT racks in the Flex AI infrastructure platform.

units.name: EPC Power
units.focus: SiC power conversion systems (grid-forming inverters/PCS, rectifiers, DC-DC) for utility BESS, microgrids and AI data centres including 800 VDC. Acquisition announced Sep 2026, close expected Q4 2026: not offered until closed.

units.name: Flex Design, Engineering and Manufacturing Services
units.focus: Product design and engineering, DfX, NPI and prototyping, test and failure analysis, advanced PCBA, box build and system integration, precision metals and plastics, and supply chain management, for automotive, healthcare, communications, cloud, industrial, lifestyle and cross-industry customers.

units.name: Flex Fulfillment, Logistics and Aftermarket Services
units.focus: Vendor-managed inventory, warehousing, kitting and late customization, fulfillment and managed logistics, plus reverse logistics, screening, repair and refurbishment, warranty, spare parts, recycling and resale.
